title: Beavers reintroduced to an English estate changed its stream within a year
summary_full: The Spains Hall Estate in Essex has welcomed the return of beavers, leading to remarkable improvements in the local ecosystem. A year after their reintroduction, studies revealed an increase in both the quantity and diversity of terrestrial invertebrates. Additionally, water quality enhancements were noted, with elevated oxygen levels and diminished nitrate concentrations.
